speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned hand tremors and recent memory issues; to begin my evaluation, how long have you noticed these symptoms, and do the tremors occur at rest or when you are using your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Parkinson's Disease with early cognitive decline or Lewy Body Dementia.

I need to clarify if there have been any episodes of sudden visual hallucinations, fluctuating alertness, or a "freezing" sensation when walking. Also, do you notice any stiffness or slowness in your movements besides the tremor?
